en: Black‑and‑white image of a small wooden church with a tall, narrow steeple. The church stands behind a white picket fence and is framed by leafy trees on both sides. Over the entrance there is an arched sign with text that appears to end in "KIRKA" or "KIRKAEN," suggesting a Scandinavian word for church. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
